text: Yes, Hansen recorded tree-cover loss within the property in 2021. The total loss area was 81.3 hectares, which is approximately 2.23% of the asset's area. This loss was primarily in planted forests, specifically Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. Additionally, there was 37.3 hectares of loss in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares, which were not counted as part of the main event. The loss was corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference, which agreed on 98% of the event area.
